name: Oaxiltso

abilities.name: Marsh Masher
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Ravenous Chomp
abilities.description: Oaxiltso performs a deep bite at his target, dealing massive physical damage. This can be blocked.

abilities.name: Savage Blitz
abilities.description: Oaxiltso charges forward and chomps the farthest (within 25m range) target, dealing massive physical damage. This can (and should) be dodged by the target and everyone on Oaxiltso's path, should he charge through the group.

abilities.name: Fiery Stomp
abilities.description: Oaxiltso performs a series of three stomping attacks, first stomping each of his feet, and ending with a jumping stomp. All three release flaming trails outward which deal high flame damage each. There isn't any AoE indicator during this ability.

abilities.name: Blistering Smash
abilities.description: Oaxiltso slams his fists into the ground, exploding the earth struck, as indicated by a large red circle. The initial hit deals very high physical damage, and the lingering area deals continuous high flame damage. This can be performed both up close or standing further away, spawning the cracked earth near his target.

abilities.name: Noxious Sludge
abilities.description: Oaxiltso retches poison on two targets in the party, prioritizing those farthest from the pools in the corners of the arena, if he can, otherwise he will select random targets. Poisoned targets will take ramping poison damage and drop Noxious Pools (small poison AOE) at their feet until they cleanse the effect by walking into the pools (which will turn the pool poisonous for a duration, dealing damage to anyone standing in it and not cleansing poisoned players).

abilities.name: Summon Havocrel Annihilators
abilities.description: At 90%/75%/50%/25% health, Oaxiltso howls to Mehrunes Dagon for aid, causing three meteors and then a Havocrel Annihilator to fall from the sky into the arena, in blasts indicated by charging AoE circles, dealing high flame damage. On Veteran difficulty, Havocrel Annihilators have a noteworthy ability to cast enraging aura on themselves shortly after entering the fight - if Oaxiltso comes in its range, both him and the Havocrel enrage, boosting damage from all sources originating from their abilities, including poison DoTs and Noxious Pools. Havocrels should be burned down as quickly as possible when they appear (the last one can be held away from the boss, instead).

abilities.name: Summon Death Hoppers
abilities.description: Occasionally, Death Hoppers are summoned during the fight to assist.

related_quests: Of Stone and Steam: Save the souls of Rockgrove's fallen and drive back the Dagonite invaders.
summary: Oaxiltso is an Argonian behemoth and a member of the Sul-Xan tribe who can be found in the Ruined Springs of Rockgrove. He is the first boss of the trial. Unlike most behemoths, his scales are red; Dust-On-Scales believes this to be some form of corruption, possibly resulting from Oaxiltso being altered somehow by Flame-Herald Bahsei's Daedric magic.
